prompt: Create ONE separate book illustration of John, the real man in the photographic references, for The Vegetable Guru. Preserve his recognisable likeness: receding hairline with wispy short grey-brown hair at the sides, high forehead, short salt-and-pepper beard and moustache, gentle eyes, friendly understated smile, ordinary proportions. Faithful middle-aged-to-older adult face, not a caricature or generic garden mascot. Clothing follows the source: open muted red/cream/navy checked shirt, plain olive T-shirt, olive shorts; omit recording microphone and logos. Translate people, clothes, tools and plants into one coherent polished, dimensional vector-like drawn style governed by the approved vegetable hero references: bold simplified silhouettes, broad overlapping colour and shadow planes, natural skin colours, rich lime/forest foliage with sparse cream tapered highlights. No black contour outlines, no stippling, no etched/pencil texture, no watercolour, no photographic texture, no glossy plastic skin. Simplify shirt checks to broad clean lines. Keep hands anatomically plausible and natural, with readable finger grips. Show only a small garden/greenhouse vignette to establish context: a short section of bed, a few recognisable plants, perhaps part of a greenhouse frame. Surrounding space and gaps must be truly transparent, not white or dark haze. NO rectangular scene background, no sky or full greenhouse, no lettering, no border. Complete silhouette with clear padding on every side, no cropped head, elbows, tools or leaf tips. Large high resolution. Images 1 and 2 provide John's identity, stance and authentic greenhouse; images 3 and 4 are the approved drawing style only. Draw a welcoming standing three-quarter-length portrait of John offering his stainless-steel colander of red tomatoes, with natural asymmetrical elbow position and the relaxed warm expression from image 1. Keep his face recognisable, no glasses on face. One sparse tomato plant and a small edge of the bed frame him gently; only a few pale greenhouse struts behind, leaving lots of open transparent space. Portrait aspect ratio. End lower figure naturally around knees behind low leaves/bed rather than a straight cut. Main emphasis face and harvest, restrained setting.
